title: God and The Ocean
excerpt: God and the Ocean are the same; they both are, and they both are not. In the name of the Ocean, all you can show me are countless drops of water. In the name of God, all you can show me are countless...
contentHtml: God and the Ocean are the same; they both are, and they both are not. In the name of the Ocean, all you can show me are countless drops of water. In the name of God, all you can show me are countless fragments of creation.
